summary: Rate limiter buckets by wall-clock second.
true_fix: Replace whole-second wall-clock buckets with a sliding window over `time.monotonic()`, so two hits milliseconds apart cannot land in different windows.
nondeterminism_source: `int(time.time())` changes at second boundaries. Two hits 40ms apart straddle a boundary a few percent of the time, and the second lands in a fresh bucket.
masking_fix: Retry the test, shorten the gap between hits until it rarely straddles a boundary, or pin the clock only in the test.
notes: The lowest flake rate in the corpus. A system that samples too few runs will conclude this test is stable.
